name: NK3 homeobox 1

function.text: NKX3-1 encodes homeobox protein Nkx-3.1. Annotated molecular activities include transcription regulator inhibitor activity and DNA-binding transcription factor activity. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.
